text:
nancy-acme: Hi team — after we enabled OIDC session rotation our product owners lost access to Project billing in the console and API calls to billing endpoints return 403. Ticket SUP-8599. Can someone help?
lauren: Thanks, nancy — which org/project and a sample API response if possible?
nancy-acme: org: acme-corp, project: data-api-prod. API sample: 
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/data-api-prod/billing
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"insufficient_scope","missing":["billing:read"]}
```
samir: That looks like the token no longer contains the billing scope. Did you change the delegated client or Okta app scopes recently?
nancy-acme: We rotated the delegated client last week. IdP said they tightened scopes to only `openid profile email` for the app and will send roles via groups claim.
mike: Quick triage notes: console expects either a token with `billing:*` scopes or an internal service exchange that maps roles to billing permissions. Repro I ran: exchange OIDC code -> token has scopes `openid profile email` -> calling billing endpoint returns the same 403: 
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"insufficient_scope","missing":["billing:read"]}
```
lauren: Short-term workarounds: 1) grant affected users an org-level admin role so UI uses admin flow, or 2) use a project-scoped API key with billing access (not ideal but unblocks invoices).
samir: @idp-team can you confirm whether the delegated client now strips custom scopes? If yes we need either to: add `billing` to allowed scopes for that client, or add a mapping on our side so groups claim -> grant billing scopes during token exchange.
idp-team: We trimmed scopes intentionally. We can add a specific `billing` scope back to the delegated client. Need a list of exact scope names you require.
mike: We'll accept `billing:read` and `billing:write` for the delegated client. In parallel we'll implement a short-term claim-mapping fallback in eng-infra to infer scopes from groups for console checks. Escalating SUP-8599 to P2 and assigning to eng-infra.
deploy-bot: Noted: idp client scope change scheduled for dev revert at 2026-03-18T01:00Z, staging after QA.
nancy-acme: Appreciate the fast response. Current impact: 6 users can't access billing UI, invoices blocked. Please ping when rolling back or if we should use the API key workaround.
mike: I'll update SUP-8599 with repro steps and ETA. For now please use API key workaround if you need immediate invoice access.
lauren: Thanks all — I'll follow up with nancy and close loop once eng confirms mapping/IdP update.
